description:
Team THE MOON - solo participant Alipp from Kedah, Malaysia, joining Kuala Lumpur Virtual. Project: KL GUARDIAN: The Next Frontier Shield. Using NASA Landsat, GPM & MODIS data to detect flood & urban heat trends in KL, with tech adaptable for Moon habitats. Skills: data visualization, storytelling, Earth science. Goal: Gold Award NSAKL26.
